primary_metric: phone server_total run mean; positive A-minus-B favors OFTEN output
transport: desk ADB TCP; not direct vehicle USB
screen_policy: off before each run per runner protocol
allocation_scope: Only precompiled Tensor outputs are imported; managed input allocation remains unchanged in both APKs.

A.label: imported output RARELY; managed inputs; SDK v2.1

B.label: imported output OFTEN; managed inputs; SDK v2.1

output_equality.scope: Finite recurrent fixture; not universal model accuracy proof

limitations: Six run pairs are the replication unit, not3600 independent experiments; two-sided exact sign-flip resolution is0.03125 at best.
Bootstrap resamples pairs. Exchangeability, approximate independence and stable device conditions remain assumptions.
Inference, queues, roundtrip and tail summaries are exploratory secondary metrics without multiplicity correction.
All frames and outliers are retained; pooled quantiles are descriptive.
Both variants are matched experimental APKs with imported outputs and common ownership/error handling; this is not a controlled production-APK comparison.
The native allocation experiment imported inputs too, so its absolute timing and effect size must not be substituted for this app comparison.
No deliberate wake, hours-long thermal, physical vehicle USB or driving qualification is established by this screen.
